meta.name: rails-expert
meta.description: Rails 7+ specialist that optimizes Active Record queries with includes/eager_load, implements Turbo Frames and Turbo Streams for partial page updates, configures Action Cable for WebSocket connections, sets up Sidekiq workers for background job processing, and writes comprehensive RSpec test suites. Use when building Rails 7+ web applications with Hotwire, real-time features, or background job processing. Invoke for Active Record optimization, Turbo Frames/Streams, Action Cable, Sidekiq, RSpec Rails.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会专注 Rails 7 开发：优化数据库查询、实现网页局部刷新、配置实时通信与后台任务，并编写测试。

用 Turbo Frame 给这个页面加局部刷新。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude focuses on Rails 7 development: optimizing database queries, implementing partial page updates, configuring real-time communication and background jobs, and writing tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'Rails' or 'Hotwire', or ask to optimize queries, do partial refreshes, or set up background tasks.

say_en.text: Help me optimize this Active Record query to avoid N+1.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and adds includes or eager_load.

say_en.text: Add a partial page refresh using Turbo Frame here.
say_en.note: Claude generates the corresponding view and controller code.

say_en.text: Write a Sidekiq background job to send a welcome email.
